ar.title: مجدّرة (عدس بجبة وأرز بالبصل المقلي)

steps.n1: غطِّ العدس بضعف حجمه ماءً واغلِه حتى يقارب النضج.
steps.n2: أضف الأرز والملح وقلّب، وغطِّ الحلة واطهه نحو 15 دقيقة حتى ينضج العدس والأرز.
steps.n3: اقلِ البصل حتى يصبح بنياً داكناً.
steps.n4: اسكب البصل وزيته على العدس وقلّب، واتركه يغلي على نار هادئة 5 دقائق أخرى.
steps.n5: قدّمها ساخنة أو باردة، ويجب أن تكون طرية كالعصيدة الكثيفة.

en.title: Mujaddara (Brown Lentils and Rice with Fried Onions)
en.intro: Recipe 208, page 94 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Cover the lentils with twice their volume of water and boil until almost done.
steps.n2: Add the rice and salt, stir, cover and cook for about 15 minutes, until both lentils and rice are tender.
steps.n3: Fry the onions until deep brown.
steps.n4: Tip the onions and their oil into the lentils, stir and simmer for 5 minutes more.
steps.n5: Serve hot or cold. It should be soft, like a thick porridge.

legacySteps: Cover the lentils with twice their volume of water and boil until almost done.
Add the rice and salt, stir, cover and cook for about 15 minutes, until both lentils and rice are tender.
Fry the onions until deep brown.
Tip the onions and their oil into the lentils, stir and simmer for 5 minutes more.
Serve hot or cold. It should be soft, like a thick porridge.
